title: PreTab DeepTab compatibility fixture v1
description: One reproducible, small synthetic case. The case ID identifies the recipe for fit and probe data; the fixture contains no training rows, estimator state, or checkpoint.

input_schema.description: Input container and ordered columns used for fit. Names and dtype strings describe the synthetic input before preprocessing.

constructor_config.description: Explicit arguments used to construct PreTab, retaining the requested values and omitted defaults. Decode ordered feature overrides before passing the arguments to PreTab.

resolved_config.description: Public get_resolved_config() for the unmodified constructor request, with tuples represented as arrays and ordered feature overrides encoded as entries. This is not fitted state.

output_feature_names.description: Exact fitted get_feature_names_out() sequence, also the column order for transformed row values.

block_widths.description: Block keys and realized column counts from transform(..., return_array=False), in returned order, even for a matrix-output case. Keys are block names, not source labels. Their widths sum to the number of output feature names. Cases do not supply external embeddings.

feature_info_dimensions.description: Only the dimension entries of the three get_feature_info(verbose=False) mappings, keyed by public feature or group name. Display text is not a contract.

fingerprint.description: Fitted fingerprint_. Compare exactly only when reproducing the recorded qualification environment, including the PreTab revision and library versions; do not require equality across environments.

transformed_rows.description: Samples from transform on synthetic probe inputs. Row indices are zero-based, unique, and ascending. Flatten blocks in output order and materialize only sampled sparse rows. Each values array has one finite number per output feature name in that order.

tolerances.description: Metadata and ordering are exact. Only transformed values use abs(actual - expected) <= atol + rtol * abs(expected), with fixture values as expected and both sides finite.

library_versions.description: Exact generating versions, not supported ranges. Record optional packages as null when absent. The qualification record identifies the tested code revisions and platform.

config.description: JSON-native settings only. Object member order is not significant. Feature group and source arrays retain their declared order.

feature_preprocessing.description: Encode a non-null label-to-override mapping as ordered entries so JSON member order cannot change reconstruction or the fingerprint.
